package httptransport

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type executionHTTPRepository struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance domain.TaskInstance
}

func (r executionHTTPRepository) GetInstance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if r.instance.StudentID != studentID || r.instance.ID != instanceID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return r.instance, nil
}

func TestExecutionProjectionHTTPRequiresRuntimeTokenAndExactOwner(t *testing.T) {
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", LearningActionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003", TaskRevisionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), Status: domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, Version: 2, WorkspaceBinding: domain.WorkspaceBinding{Available: true}, Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "milestone-one", Required: true, Status: "AVAILABLE"}}}
	handler := (&Server{InternalToken: "runtime-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token", Runtime: &usecase.Runtime{Repository: executionHTTPRepository{instance: instance}}}).Handler()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, token, student string
		status               int
	}{
		{"service", "runtime-token", instance.StudentID, 200}, {"missing token", "", instance.StudentID, 401}, {"teacher forbidden", "teacher-token", instance.StudentID, 401}, {"wrong owner", "runtime-token", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099", 404}, {"missing owner", "runtime-token", "", 400},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/v2/task-instances/"+instance.ID+"/execution-projection?student_id="+tc.student, nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", tc.token)
			writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
			if writer.Code != tc.status {
				t.Fatalf("status %d: %s", writer.Code, writer.Body.String())
			}
			if writer.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
				t.Fatal("projection can be cached")
			}
			if tc.status == 200 {
				var got usecase.ExecutionProjection
				if err := json.Unmarshal(writer.Body.Bytes(), &got); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if got.Schema != "practice-execution-projection.v1" || got.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID || got.StudentID != instance.StudentID || got.StepID != "milestone-one" || got.SubmissionScope != "MILESTONE" {
					t.Fatalf("projection %+v", got)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
